title: What Programming Is & How the Web Works
learning_objectives: Explain what a program is in plain language
Describe the client–server model of the web
Define API (Application Programming Interface) at a high level
course_context: What full-stack development means at a high level
How this lesson connects to the larger curriculum
How hands-on projects and lessons will work
outline: Orientation: What is this course? What is full-stack development?
What happens when you type a URL
APIs as contracts between software pieces
expected_outcomes: Learner can verbally explain what a program is
Learner can describe how a browser request becomes a response
Learner can use a simple metaphor to explain API
exercise: Draw a diagram of the client–server request cycle

reflection_prompt: What surprised you most about programming?
What feels exciting or intimidating at this point?

constraints_for_professor: Define all acronyms on first use
Do not show code beyond tiny snippets
Keep focus on mental models, not configuration
